copy.ogopogoIsATrueTeam: Ogopogo is a true team effort that will continue to evolve moving toward RoboSub 2026. Each improvement builds on what we've learned from previous challenges, testing sessions at the Kelowna Family YMCA, and judge feedback in California.
copy.modularAluminumChassisWaterproofAcrylic: Modular aluminum chassis, waterproof acrylic pressure hull, custom modular battery enclosure, internal electronics sliding tray, pneumatic torpedo and dropper actuators.
copy.redesignedStm32f7StandaloneMcuDedicated: Redesigned STM32F7 standalone MCU, dedicated Actuator Board, heavy-duty Power Distribution Board (PDB), magnetic kill switch, custom Battery Management System (BMS), and subsea acoustic hydrophones.
copy.layered5TierControlHierarchy: Layered 5-tier control hierarchy, ROS2 nodes, automated state machine mission planner, OpenCV & YOLOv8 perception, acoustic time-difference-of-arrival (TDoA) localization, and Stonefish simulation.

intro.heading: The AUV — Ogopogo
intro.summary: Say hello to Ogopogo, our second-generation autonomous underwater vehicle built for RoboSub in California.
